name: Ley of the Land
summary: Izvi Gildfizz believes a rift above Lake Mennar may be an open leyline. She wants you to siphon its magic and bring her the Tear of Mennar.

sections.title: A Rift Above the Water
sections.body: Izvi Gildfizz asks you to investigate the rift she spotted above Lake Mennar. While surveying for untapped resources, she saw it floating over the water but could not get close. She suspects it is an open leyline. With a Mana-Siphoning Wand, you can draw magic from the rift and bring Izvi the Tear of Mennar.

faq.answer: Izvi Gildfizz surveyed the area for untapped resources and spotted a rift above Lake Mennar.

faq.q: What did Izvi find at Lake Mennar?
faq.answer: Izvi saw a huge rift floating above the water and thinks it may be an open leyline.

faq.q: What does Izvi want me to do?
faq.answer: Izvi wants you to use a Mana-Siphoning Wand on the Leyline Rift and bring her the Tear of Mennar.

faq.q: Why does Izvi want the leyline's magic?
faq.answer: Izvi hopes to bottle the siphoned magic and sell it to the highest bidder.
